name: agentic-helpers
description: Memory that survives compaction, a shared helper-script library, a scratch sweep, a decision-graph grounding gate, checked graph captures and a Bash guard, each with a skill

embedding_provider.title: Embedding provider
embedding_provider.description: Where search by meaning gets its embedder: auto follows sdd's embedding configuration, sending no API key; openai (any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) and ollama use the embedding options below; off turns search by meaning off and never runs sdd for it, keyword search keeps working; default auto

embedding_model.title: Embedding model
embedding_model.description: The model the endpoint serves, e.g. embeddinggemma-300m-6bit; default none

embedding_endpoint.title: Embedding endpoint
embedding_endpoint.description: Base URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:1235; default the provider's own

embedding_dimensions.title: Embedding dimensions
embedding_dimensions.description: Vector length to ask the model for; 0 keeps the model's own; default 0

embedding_api_key_env.title: API key variable
embedding_api_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable holding a hosted embedder's key; the key itself is never stored; default none

embedding_timeout.title: Embedding timeout
embedding_timeout.description: How long one embedding call of a command may take, a span such as 30s or 2m; hooks keep a shorter limit; default 2m

embedding_query_template.title: Embedding query template
embedding_query_template.description: Wraps a search query or prompt before it is embedded, {text} marking where it goes, e.g. "task: search result | query: {text}"; default none

embedding_document_template.title: Embedding document template
embedding_document_template.description: Wraps a memory entry or tool description before it is embedded, {text} marking where it goes, e.g. "title: none | text: {text}"; default none

entry_max_words.title: Entry word limit
entry_max_words.description: Words an entry should stay within; longer entries still land, with a note; default 500

state_stale_after_writes.title: File writes before a state hold
state_stale_after_writes.description: File writes since a memory seat's last state write that hold the turn's end once for a new one; default 5

entry_id_length.title: Entry id length
entry_id_length.description: Characters after m- in a new entry id, 6 to 16; ids already filed keep working; default 6

brief_note_limit.title: Brief note limit
brief_note_limit.description: Notes the memory brief prints, hottest first; the rest stay one agentic-memory brief --kind note away; default 10

attachment_max_mb.title: Attachment size limit
attachment_max_mb.description: Megabytes one file attached to a memory entry may hold; default 10

attachments_total_mb.title: Attachment limit for the machine
attachments_total_mb.description: Megabytes every file attached to memory entries may hold together, across every project on the machine, each file counted once; never below attachment_max_mb; default 2048

memory_require_git.title: Memory only inside git
memory_require_git.description: Keep agentic-memory to git work trees; off lets a directory outside git keep a store keyed by its own path; default on

memory_turns_off_auto.title: Seat claim turns off Claude Code's auto memory
memory_turns_off_auto.description: A seat claim writes autoMemoryEnabled: false into the project's .claude/settings.local.json, from the next session; off leaves the file alone; default on

memory_language.title: Memory entry language
memory_language.description: Locale entries are written in where the project's .sdd/config.yaml names none, e.g. de; default en

writing_style.title: Writing style
writing_style.description: terse or plain: how agents write memory entries, the state and tool library notes; graph entries stay plain prose; default terse

tools_query_floor.title: Tool query floor
tools_query_floor.description: Cosine at or above which agentic-tools counts a tool as near a search or a prompt; depends on the embedder; default 0.45

memory_enabled.title: Switch on agentic-memory
memory_enabled.description: agentic-memory: seats, entries, recall and their hooks; off, its commands refuse and its hooks say nothing; default on

tools_enabled.title: Switch on agentic-tools
tools_enabled.description: agentic-tools: the helper tool library and its hooks; off, its commands refuse and its hooks say nothing; default on

scratch_enabled.title: Switch on the scratch sweep
scratch_enabled.description: agentic-scratch: a scratch folder per seat or session under .tmp/claude/, swept when the work ends; off, shell-guard's mktemp ban goes off with it; default on

scratch_sweep.title: Scratch folder sweep
scratch_sweep.description: When a seat's .tmp/claude/<seat>/ folder goes: release (at agentic-memory release), session (when its session ends) or idle (only after a week unused); default release

grounding_gate_enabled.title: Switch on the grounding gate
grounding_gate_enabled.description: agentic-grounding-gate: the sdd reads owed before a question, draft or capture; off, agentic-capture goes off with it; default on

capture_enabled.title: Switch on agentic-capture
capture_enabled.description: agentic-capture: capturing sdd entries from drafts; off, it refuses; default on

capture_remove_draft.title: agentic-capture: remove the draft
capture_remove_draft.description: Delete a draft once its entry is captured, unless git tracks it or it lies outside the work tree and /tmp; off keeps every draft; default on

shell_guard_enabled.title: Switch on shell-guard
shell_guard_enabled.description: agentic-shell-guard: holding Bash removals to the project and banning mktemp; off, every Bash call runs unjudged; default on

shell_guard_outside_project.title: Shell-guard: removals outside the project
shell_guard_outside_project.description: ask, deny or off for an rm, rmdir, unlink or git rm reaching outside the project and /tmp, or a command whose name is not fixed text, passed arguments or able to split into words (an ask there refuses twice per session first); default ask

shell_guard_find_delete.title: Shell-guard: find -delete
shell_guard_find_delete.description: ask, deny or off for find ... -delete; default ask

shell_guard_lone_removal.title: Shell-guard: removals run alone
shell_guard_lone_removal.description: Deny a removal that is not the whole Bash command: no other statement, pipe, redirection, subshell or wrapper; default on

shell_guard_expansion.title: Shell-guard: literal removal targets
shell_guard_expansion.description: Deny a removal whose target is built from a variable or command substitution; default on

shell_guard_nested_code.title: Shell-guard: nested code
shell_guard_nested_code.description: Deny a removal or mktemp inside eval, a shell's -c, or inline code for another interpreter; default on

shell_guard_mktemp.title: Shell-guard: mktemp
shell_guard_mktemp.description: Deny mktemp anywhere in a Bash command; scratch files go under the project's .tmp/; default on

shell_guard_alternatives.title: Shell-guard: command alternatives
shell_guard_alternatives.description: Refuse a Bash call naming a command missing here (timeout) or a usage its BSD flavour gets wrong (sed -i, date -d), naming the command that works, and say at session start what this machine needs; default on

shell_guard_secrets.title: Shell-guard: credentials in a command
shell_guard_secrets.description: ask, deny or off for a Bash command holding what looks like a credential (a token, a key); an ask refuses twice per session first, so the agent can rewrite it; default ask

shell_guard_secret_output.title: Shell-guard: credentials in tool output
shell_guard_secret_output.description: all, files or off: withhold each line looking like a credential from tool output that comes from outside the project; files limits it to Read, Grep, NotebookRead, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit and Bash; default all

shell_guard_secret_output_skip.title: Shell-guard: tools whose output is never withheld
shell_guard_secret_output_skip.description: Comma-separated tool names or patterns, e.g. WebFetch, mcp__sdd__*; default none

shell_guard_ask_timeout.title: Shell-guard: ask countdown
shell_guard_ask_timeout.description: How long a shell-guard ask waits for an answer in auto and bypassPermissions mode before it denies: a span such as 45s or 2m, at most 1h; a bare number counts seconds; 0 waits without limit; default 2m

tools_duplicate_floor.title: Tool duplicate floor
tools_duplicate_floor.description: Cosine at or above which agentic-tools refuses a new tool's description as another tool's, unless --distinct says how it differs; default 0.85

update_notice.title: Update notice
update_notice.description: A seat claim says once a day that a newer agentic-helpers release exists while auto-update is off for its marketplace, which the agent relays; off, no notice and no release check; default on
